[[Hearthome Gym]] }} '''Mirages of Mismagius I''' (Japanese: '''VS ムウマージI''' ''VS Mismagius I''), titled '''VS Mismagius I''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 372nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 35th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Hearthome Gym and a Math Problem''' (Japanese: '''ヨスガジムと計算問題''' ''Yosuga Gym and Calculations'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Hearthome Gym and Miscalculations''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The [[Advanced level Grunt]] challenges [[Mr. Berlitz]] to phone his bodyguards. With his hand shaking, Mr. Berlitz does so, and his fears build with every second he waits for the call to be picked up. The grunt claims that [[Paka and Uji]] were banished from the world, and shows him video proof of their final moments. Mr. Berlitz becomes so horrified that he drops his [[Pokégear]]. He thus demands for his daughter's whereabouts. The grunt calms him down by saying that his daughter is safe, and asks for a mere {{PDollar}}1.5 billion to release her, which is not a lot for a wealthy family. Mr. Berlitz suddenly wonders why the grunt needs so much money. The grunt responds with his team name: [[Team Galactic]]. Meanwhile, the main trio are making their way through the doors inside the [[Hearthome Gym]]. {{adv|Pearl}} gets impatient that their obstacles are merely simple math questions, and {{adv|Diamond}} makes a joke about it. Finally, {{adv|Platinum}} gets through to the chamber where [[Fantina]] is waiting. Fantina tells her {{p|Mismagius}} to be patient - she calls forth {{p|Duskull}} to start the battle. Platinum calls forth Diamond's {{adv|Lax}}. Being grateful to Diamond for lending it to her, Platinum commands a {{m|Lick}} from it. The supereffective attack easily knocks Duskull out. Platinum switches Lax out for her {{TP|Platinum|Empoleon}} as Fantina sends in her {{TP|Fantina|Drifblim}}. Immediately, Drifblim begins to use {{m|Ominous Wind}}. Empoleon initially appears to hold back, but then unleashes a powerful {{m|Blizzard}} to knock Drifblim out. Complimenting Platinum on her strategies thus far, Fantina finally calls out her Mismagius. Upon Mismagius' entry, Empoleon begins to feel dizzy. Platinum soon finds herself in a jungle. Pearl notices the illusion as well and tells Platinum to end the battle quickly. Platinum thus orders a {{m|Metal Claw}} from Empoleon, but Mismagius lands its attack before Empoleon and knocks Empoleon out. Platinum immediately complains because she thought her Empoleon was faster. Fantina spins around, saying that logic is out of the window in her current situation. Platinum thus sends in her {{TP|Platinum|Ponyta}} to continue with the battle, however, it is caught out by one of Mismagius' illusions and is knocked out by a {{m|Dark Pulse}}. Now down to one Pokémon just like her opponent, Platinum brings out Lax once again. ==Major events== * [[Mr. Berlitz]] finds out that [[Paka and Uji]] have disappeared. * The [[Advanced level Grunt]] reveals that he is from [[Team Galactic]]. * {{adv|Platinum}} begins her battle against [[Fantina]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Fantina]] * [[Paka and Uji]] (picture) * [[Advanced level Grunt]] * [[Mr. Berlitz]] * Gym Statue ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Drifblim}} ({{OP|Fantina|Drifblim}}) * {{p|Mismagius}} ([[Fantina]]'s) * {{p|Duskull}} ([[Fantina]]'s) * {{p|Burmy}} ([[Paka and Uji|Paka]]'s; {{form|Burmy|Trash Cloak}}; picture) * {{p|Buizel}} ([[Paka and Uji|Uji]]'s; picture) * {{p|Chingling}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) * {{p|Gible}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) * {{p|Staraptor}} ([[Advanced level Grunt]]'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 夢妖魔I|VS Mismagius I}} (Taiwan)
